classification.resume: This video is a Swiss TV news report covering the 2007 Lausanne court ruling that convicted Dogu Perincek for denying the Armenian genocide under anti-racism law. It shows Perincek leaving the courthouse surrounded by supporters and journalists, along with statements from Sarkis Shahinian and Eric Cottier.
